package courseplan

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type DiagnosticPlanningRequest struct {
	RequestID      string                  `json:"request_id"`
	Status         domain.CoursePlanStatus `json:"status"`
	ResultCode     string                  `json:"result_code,omitempty"`
	FailureCode    string                  `json:"failure_code,omitempty"`
	LearningPathID string                  `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
}

func validID(raw string) bool { id, err := uuid.Parse(raw); return err == nil && id.String() == raw }

type DiagnosticPlanningState struct {
	Schema            string                     `json:"schema"`
	PlanID            string                     `json:"plan_id"`
	GoalCode          string                     `json:"goal_code"`
	OnboardingVersion int64                      `json:"onboarding_version"`
	DirectionCode     string                     `json:"direction_code"`
	Request           *DiagnosticPlanningRequest `json:"request,omitempty"`
}

type GetDiagnosticPlanning struct {
	Plans    repository.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRepository
	Requests repository.DiagnosticPlanningRepository
}

func (g GetDiagnosticPlanning) Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID, planID string) (DiagnosticPlanningState, error) {
	if g.Plans == nil || g.Requests == nil || !validID(studentID) || !validID(planID) {
		return DiagnosticPlanningState{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	plan, err := g.Plans.GetDiagnosticByID(ctx, planID)
	if err != nil {
		return DiagnosticPlanningState{}, err
	}
	if plan.Plan.StudentID != studentID {
		return DiagnosticPlanningState{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if domain.ValidateDiagnosticPlanRecord(plan) != nil {
		return DiagnosticPlanningState{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	state := DiagnosticPlanningState{Schema: "diagnostic-planning-state.v1", PlanID: planID, GoalCode: plan.BindingGoalCode, OnboardingVersion: plan.Plan.OnboardingVersion, DirectionCode: plan.BindingDirectionCode}
	request, err := g.Requests.GetDiagnosticPlanningRequest(ctx, studentID, planID)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return state, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return DiagnosticPlanningState{}, err
	}
	if request.StudentID != studentID || request.DiagnosticPlanID != planID || request.GoalCode != state.GoalCode || request.Intent.Source != domain.PlanningSourceTeacher || request.Intent.Reason != domain.PlanningReasonInitial {
		return DiagnosticPlanningState{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	state.Request = &DiagnosticPlanningRequest{RequestID: request.ID, Status: request.Status, ResultCode: request.ResultCode, FailureCode: request.FailureCode, LearningPathID: request.LearningPathID}
	return state, nil
}
